[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Just a basic portrait mod for dateable jodi. This is for the seasonal dateable portrait, so you need the basic mod this comes from, the seasonal. This is the pink hair version only, because I made this in a single day. If I get a couple of requests for a brown hair version, Ill upload that one too.[/color]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Just replace all of the portraits in the dateable jodi mod and the seasonal jodi mod with these ones. I made it easy to replace, so you dont have to change anything, just drag, drop, and press yes to replace. You need the mods or else this wont work.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Thanks to the people who made the OG portrait mod, and even more so to the person who made the Jodi dateable mod. Have fun w/ ur jodi.[/b][/size]
